name: insurance_claim
title: Insurance claim intake
description: Triage a home or travel insurance claim record: is it covered, what's missing, how fast to handle it.
writes: a home or travel insurance claim as submitted through an online form

fields.policy: policy type, coverage limits and the main exclusions, 2-4 lines
fields.claim: what happened, when, where and the amount claimed
fields.documents: the documents attached so far, comma-separated (may be few)

ask: Is this claim likely covered by the policy?
Does the policy appear to cover this loss?

labels.yes: the loss fits the coverage and no exclusion applies
labels.no: an exclusion applies or the loss is outside the coverage

ask: What is the main thing missing before this claim can be assessed?

labels.proof_of_loss: receipts, photos or a police or incident report
labels.proof_of_ownership: evidence the item belonged to the claimant

ask: How urgently should this claim be handled?

labels.soon: the customer is out of pocket or inconvenienced
labels.urgent: the customer is stranded, unsafe or without a home
